videos.title: Duck Unders For BJJ Gi & No Gi
videos.whyUseful: A full duck under tutorial for jiu-jitsu that covers the level change, the wrist tie and the circle, and shows the grip-free version that carries over to no-gi.

videos.title: THE FIRST SHOT EVERYONE SHOULD LEARN. THE DUCK UNDER! #nogijiujitsu  #wrestling  #takedowns #nogi
videos.whyUseful: Frames the duck under as the first lower-body entry to learn and treats the level change and the front-choke risk explicitly for no-gi.

videos.title: BASIC TAKEDOWNS for Grappling: Level Change & Penetration Step Tutorial
videos.whyUseful: Breaks down the level change and the penetration step on their own, which are the two movements the duck under is built from.
